title: Nixon's 1960 assassination team killed JFK

tellings.quote: that in fact the assassination team that was created back in 1960 by Richard Nixon are the ones that killed the president

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and researcher, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that he was told about a secret assassination team that Richard Nixon set up in 1960. According to Sheehan, the same team later killed President John F. Kennedy in Dallas in 1963. He links the claim to people including Santo Trafficante, Andy Toney and William Johnstone Taylor, and if true it would mean the killing grew out of an earlier government plan.
